_comment: Generated by a production's own casting script; this copy is a schema
example so `PeepsActors.jsx` has something to import. A board only draws
`bodies` is the wardrobe, and it is the whole reason this file names
drawings rather than poses. The pack's sixty-one bodies are sixty-one
outfits, so a character must be given one drawing per attitude and every
one of them must be the same clothes. Only two families pass that test.
The two below are those families, and they are inverses of each other,
which is also what makes two characters read apart in a two-shot.
Shot entries: x0/x1 are where the figure starts and ends in scene units,
`height` is crown-to-sole in those same units (never a scale factor, so
a character cannot change size when its pose changes), `frames` is the
shot length, `pose` keys into `bodies`, and `face` overrides the resting
